reference_sql:
SELECT country_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN order_id END) AS store_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN order_id END) AS web_orders
FROM sales
GROUP BY country_code
alternatives: SELECT country_code, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') AS store_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS web_orders FROM sales GROUP BY country_code

SELECT country_code, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN order_id ELSE NULL END) AS store_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN order_id ELSE NULL END) AS web_orders FROM sales GROUP BY 1
